ei.title: Amount of E-waste Generated by Types of Appliances
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: The graph above shows the amount of electronic waste (e-waste) generated by different types of appliances in 2022, measured in megatonnes (Mt), along with their collection rates. For all appliance types, the amount of uncollected e-waste exceeded that of the collected e-waste, with the largest gap observed in small equipment. Large equipment followed small equipment in total e-waste generation, producing approximately 15 Mt, but it had a higher volume of collected e-waste than any other type, with a collection rate exceeding 30%. Although the total e-waste generated by small equipment was more than that of temperature exchange equipment, the volume of e-waste collected from the latter was greater than that of the former. Both monitors and small IT & telecommunication equipment generated less e-waste than small equipment, large equipment, and temperature exchange equipment, but had higher collection rates than all three. Lamps produced the least amount of e-waste among all the appliance types, and their collection rate was also the lowest.
